# Sirach Chapter 49 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 49 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_049_page_001.jpg

---

49:1 The memory of Josiah is like a blending of incense, prepared by the work of the perfumer; in every mouth it will be sweet as honey, and like music at a banquet of wine.

49:2 He behaved rightly in the conversion of the people and took away the abominations of lawlessness.

49:3 He directed his heart toward the Lord; in the days of the lawless he confirmed piety.

49:4 Except for David and Hezekiah and Josiah, all committed great offenses; for they forsook the law of the Most High — the kings of Judah failed to the very last.

49:5 So they gave their power to others and their glory to a foreign nation,

49:6 who set fire to the chosen city of the sanctuary and made its streets desolate, as was prophesied by Jeremiah.

49:7 For they had mistreated him, who was consecrated as a prophet from his mother's womb, to pull up and to afflict and to destroy, and likewise to build and to plant.

49:8 It was Ezekiel who saw the vision of glory, which God showed him over the chariot of the cherubim.

49:9 For he also mentioned Job, who held fast to all the ways of justice.

49:10 And may the bones of the twelve prophets sprout again from their places! For they comforted the people of Jacob and rescued them with confident hope.

49:11 How shall we magnify Zerubbabel? He also was like a signet ring on the right hand.

49:12 So was Jeshua son of Jozadak; who in their days built the house and raised up the holy temple of the Lord, prepared for everlasting glory.

49:13 Also the memory of Nehemiah is great; he raised up for us the walls that had fallen and set up gates and bars and rebuilt our houses.

49:14 No one created on earth has been like Enoch, for he was taken up from the earth.

49:15 Nor was any man like Joseph born, and his body was cared for.

49:16 Shem and Seth were honored among men, and above every living thing was Adam in his creation.
